in_arabic.name: Nadi
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nadi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic word ‘nadī’, meaning a friend, companion, or helper. In the Quran, Nadi refers to a helper or messenger.

in_urdu.name: Nadi
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Friend
in_urdu.long_meaning: Nadi ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ From the Arabic word ‘nadī’, meaning a friend, companion, or helper. In the Quran, Nadi refers to a helper or messenger.

in_hindi.name: Nadi
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Friend
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nadi एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Arabic word ‘nadī’, meaning a friend, companion, or helper. In the Quran, Nadi refers to a helper or messenger.

in_pashto.name: Nadi
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Friend
in_pashto.long_meaning: Nadi یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. From the Arabic word ‘nadī’, meaning a friend, companion, or helper. In the Quran, Nadi refers to a helper or messenger.
